title: He Laughed at a $50 Million Offer. It Cost Billions #shorts
description:
In 2000, Blockbuster could have bought Netflix for fifty million dollars. It said no, and a few years later it was gone.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:

lines.text: In two thousand, a tiny startup offered to sell itself for fifty million dollars.
The giant it asked laughed in its face.
That giant was Blockbuster, with nine thousand stores around the world.
The startup was Netflix. It mailed DVDs to your door.
Blockbuster called it a niche business, and walked away.
Its real money came from late fees. Hundreds of millions of dollars a year.
Netflix had no late fees, and then it started streaming.
Blockbuster lost its customers, then its stores.
In two thousand and ten, it filed for bankruptcy.
Today, Netflix is worth hundreds of billions of dollars.
And only one Blockbuster store is still open, in Oregon.
